name: decoupled-fixture-projects-planned-row
body: The decoupled-validation fixture's pending arm projects its plan-store declaration with artifacts::write_jsonl_and_reingest rather than a full scan, so the planned row exists without re-running the frontends; it proves the Pending universe the projection writes, not the scan's own planned-row materialisation. Upgrade to a scan-based projection if the planned-row projection path stops covering Record::PlannedNode.
